name: Kimberly Lifschitz
office: Beverly Hills Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Kimberly Lifschitz is a paralegal and former preschool teacher. She has served as a room parent and PTA executive board member. She has frequently criticized board decisions during public meetings.

sentences.text: Kimberly Lifschitz is a paralegal and former preschool teacher.
She has served as a room parent and PTA executive board member.
She has frequently criticized board decisions during public meetings.

items.text: In 2025 she urged the board to protect special education funding as federal cuts loomed. She has called for more public information about education technology products the district buys and for a filtering system in which websites need approval before students can access them. She also proposed phone pouches during the school day. At a student forum she backed a one-year moratorium on generative AI, saying it could weaken critical thinking, and proposed a teaching and early childhood education pathway.
